name: @havahr/mcp-calculators

tools.name: calculate_malaysia_payroll
tools.description: Calculate Malaysian net pay with EPF, SOCSO, EIS, and PCB deductions plus employer contributions. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

epfGrossSalary.description: Optional EPF wage base in RM (e.g. include bonus). Defaults to grossSalary.

socsoGrossSalary.description: Optional SOCSO wage base in RM. Defaults to grossSalary.

eisGrossSalary.description: Optional EIS wage base in RM. Defaults to grossSalary.

isNonMalaysianMemberBefore1998.description: Non-Malaysian EPF member before Aug 1998. Default false.

epfEmployeeRate.description: Optional EPF employee rate override as percentage (e.g. 11).

daysInMalaysia.description: Days in Malaysia for tax residency. Default 365.

omitPcb.description: When true, PCB is zeroed and excluded from aggregates.

tools.name: calculate_epf
tools.description: Calculate Malaysian EPF (KWSP) employee and employer contributions from official Third Schedule rates. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

grossSalary.description: Monthly gross wage for EPF in RM

employeeRate.description: Optional employee contribution rate override as percentage (e.g. 11).

tools.name: calculate_socso
tools.description: Calculate Malaysian SOCSO (PERKESO) contributions (Category 1 under 60, Category 2 for 60+). Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

grossSalary.description: Monthly gross wage for SOCSO in RM

employeeAge.description: Employee age. Under 60 = Category 1; 60+ = Category 2. Default 30.

tools.name: calculate_eis
tools.description: Calculate Malaysian EIS (SIP) contributions with eligibility (citizen or PR, age 18–60). Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

grossSalary.description: Monthly gross wage for EIS in RM

isPermanentResident.description: Malaysia PR. When true, treated as EIS-eligible (same as citizen). Default false.

tools.name: calculate_pcb
tools.description: Estimate Malaysian PCB / monthly tax deduction (MTD) from salary and tax category inputs. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

epfContribution.description: Optional monthly EPF employee contribution in RM (used to infer EPF rate).

tools.name: calculate_employer_cost
tools.description: Calculate total employer outlay for a Malaysian salary: gross plus statutory employer contributions. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

epfGrossSalary.description: Optional EPF wage base in RM (e.g. include bonus). Defaults to grossSalary.

socsoGrossSalary.description: Optional SOCSO wage base in RM. Defaults to grossSalary.

eisGrossSalary.description: Optional EIS wage base in RM. Defaults to grossSalary.

isNonMalaysianMemberBefore1998.description: Non-Malaysian EPF member before Aug 1998. Default false.

epfEmployeeRate.description: Optional EPF employee rate override as percentage (e.g. 11).

daysInMalaysia.description: Days in Malaysia for tax residency. Default 365.

omitPcb.description: When true, PCB is zeroed and excluded from aggregates.

tools.name: calculate_overtime
tools.description: Calculate Malaysian overtime pay under the Employment Act 1955: normal day 1.5x, rest day 2x/3x, public holiday 2x daily rate plus 3x hourly OT, with 45-hour week and 104-hour monthly OT compliance checks. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

monthlySalary.description: Monthly basic salary in RM (ordinary rate = salary / 26)

normalHoursPerDay.description: Normal working hours per day. Default 8.

normalDayOtHours.description: OT hours on normal working days this month (paid 1.5x hourly). Default 0.

restDayOtHoursFirst8.description: Hours worked on rest days within normal shift length (paid 2x hourly). Default 0.

restDayOtHoursBeyond8.description: Rest-day hours beyond normal shift length (paid 3x hourly). Default 0.

publicHolidayWorkedDays.description: Public holidays worked at the usual shift length (paid 2x daily rate per day). Default 0.

publicHolidayOtHours.description: Extra hours beyond the usual shift on public holidays (paid 3x hourly). Default 0.

weeklyHours.description: Normal weekly working hours, for the 45-hour compliance check. Default 45.

monthlyOtHours.description: Total OT hours this month, for the 104-hour compliance check. Defaults to the sum of OT hours above.

tools.name: calculate_leave_proration
tools.description: Prorate Malaysian annual leave entitlement for mid-year joiners or leavers by calendar or service year, with optional unpaid-leave adjustment. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

annualEntitlement.description: Full-year annual leave entitlement in days

usedLeave.description: Annual leave days already taken. Default 0.

cutoffDate.description: Proration cutoff date, e.g. year end or termination date (YYYY-MM-DD)

basis.description: Proration basis: calendar year or service year. Default calendar.

unpaidLeaveDays.description: Unpaid leave days to reduce entitlement (1 month unpaid reduces ~1/12). Default 0.

useDayProration.description: Use day-level proration instead of month-level (calendar basis only). Default false.

tools.name: check_employment_act_coverage
tools.description: Check whether an employee is covered by the Malaysian Employment Act 1955 (RM4,000 threshold, manual labor, domestic work) with rationale and references. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

monthlySalary.description: Monthly wages in RM (RM4,000 threshold applies to key entitlements)

isManualLabor.description: Employee mainly performs manual labor. Default false.

isDomesticServant.description: Employee is a domestic servant/worker. Default false.

hasSpecialExclusion.description: Special exclusions apply (e.g. seafarers, statutory bodies). Default false.

tools.name: calculate_hrd_corp_levy
tools.description: Calculate the Malaysian HRD Corp (HRDF) levy: mandatory 1% for 10+ Malaysian employees, voluntary 0.5% for 5-9, with monthly/annual levy and training budget. Malaysia statutory estimates from HavaHR (same engine as https://www.havahr.com free calculators). Estimates only — not official advice. Confirm with KWSP/PERKESO/LHDN or a payroll professional for filing.

totalWages.description: Total eligible monthly wages in RM (basic + fixed allowances + commissions; excludes OT, bonus, reimbursements)

employeeCount.description: Number of Malaysian employees (foreign workers do not count toward the threshold)

isVoluntary.description: Employer with 5-9 employees opting into voluntary registration at 0.5%. Default false.
